title: [KIP] Kill Item Plugin
description: This plugin adds the command /killitem, which is basically just /kill @e[type=item]. I'm too lazy to type @e[type=], so I made this plugin.
body:
## IMPORTANT: This plugin is **archived** and **will not receive any further updates** (unless I need it for a newer version of the game, which is unlikely to happen). ## What does this plugin do? This plugin adds a shorter command for /kill @e[type=item]. Now you can simply use **/killitem** and all items will be deleted! ###
## But why...?
If you're wondering, "Why would anyone program such a plugin?": I'm simply too lazy to type /kill @e[type=item] every time I want to kill items that have been dropped somewhere for whatever reason... So yeah... Have fun deleting your stuff!
